industries.description: Protests outside the premises of a small gold retailer and trader have laid bare the extent of disruption caused by speculative buying across China that is powering a record-breaking metals rally.

industries.title: UK Warns of Pancreatitis, Deaths Tied to Wegovy, Mounjaro
industries.description: The UK warned some patients have died of severe inflammation of the pancreas linked to obesity and diabetes drugs such as Eli Lilly & Co.’s Mounjaro and Novo Nordisk A/S’s Wegovy.

industries.title: Chinalco, Rio Tinto to Buy Cia. Brasileira de Aluminio
industries.description: Aluminum Corp. of China will acquire a controlling interest in Cia. Brasileira de Alumínio, in a deal that would give Rio Tinto Group a one-third stake, the buyers confirmed in statements on Friday.

industries.title: Ryan Reynolds’ Wrexham Tied Up in Collapse of FX Broker Argentex
industries.description: Wrexham AFC, the Welsh soccer club controlled by Hollywood stars Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney and backed by Apollo Global Management Inc., has been caught up in the collapse of UK currency brokerage Argentex Group Plc.

industries.title: Even London’s Ever-Optimistic Brokers See Gloom for Luxury Homes
industries.description: London’s top property brokers, who have overestimated house price growth in the city’s priciest neighborhoods for years, have finally thrown in the towel.
